description: Look up companies in ANAF's public VAT registry by CIF: name, trade register number, registered office, CAEN code, and the statuses an invoice depends on (vatPayer with its current period, vatOnCollection, splitVat, inactive, and eFacturaRegistry for the RO e-Factura registry). notFound lists the CIFs ANAF does not know. A status ANAF did not report is absent, not false. Needs no grant.

cifs.description: 1 to 100 CIFs, with or without the RO prefix.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the statuses as they stood that day. Empty means today in Bucharest.

name: lookup_company
title: Look up Romanian companies
